title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. However, with busy lives, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that provide pregnant women with nutritious and delicious weeknight meals.

## Nutritional Analysis
The recipes below are selected based on the principle of providing adequate protein, fiber, and calcium for pregnant women. Protein helps build and repair body tissues, fiber supports the digestive system, and calcium helps develop the baby's bones and teeth.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Potato Soup
Chicken and potato soup is a simple but nutritious meal. Chicken provides protein, potatoes provide fiber and calcium.

### 2. Beef Stir-Fry with Broccoli
Beef stir-fry with broccoli is a nutritious meal rich in protein and fiber. Beef provides protein, broccoli provides fiber and vitamins.

### 3. Fried Eggs with Salad
Fried eggs with salad is a simple but nutritious meal. Eggs provide protein, salad provides fiber and vitamins.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a nutritious meal rich in calcium and fiber. Yogurt provides calcium, fruit provides fiber and vitamins.

### 5. Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
Chicken and vegetable fried rice is a simple but nutritious meal. Chicken provides protein, vegetables provide fiber and vitamins.

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, pregnant women should note the following principles:
- Cook food before eating
- Avoid eating uncooked or undercooked food
- Wash hands before preparing meals

Pregnant women can also refer to the [meal planner](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner) for daily meal suggestions.

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women have any questions or concerns about nutrition or health, they should consult their doctor or a nutrition expert.
